'''Bortis''' was a [[Taurill/Legends|Taurill]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Bortis showed the ability to play the sport of [[Greenputt]] with some degree of skill. As Taurills were classified as a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the discovery that Bortis could play Greenputt, coupled with a group of three non-sentient [[Neek (creature)|neek]]s also managing to play the game, lead to the establishment of the [[Non-Sentient Professional Greenputt Tour]] to accommodate the new players.<ref name="Hnn" />
